metadata.citation: Gibler, Douglas M. 2009. International Military Alliances, 1648-2008. CQ Press.

typology.Type I: Defense Pact: Obligation to militarily intervene on behalf of ally if attacked
typology.Type IIa/IIb: Non-Aggression Pact: Pledge to refrain from military force or aggression against the partner
typology.Type II: Neutrality Pact: Pledge to maintain neutrality if partner is attacked by a third state
typology.Type III: Entente: Consultation and joint strategic coordination in geopolitical crises
